dev
[✓] ssh login good (deploy).
+ ssh -p 2222 -o BatchMode=yes -o 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes' -o 'ConnectTimeout 25' -i "<CONFIG_DIR>/id_rsa" deploy@example.com 'exit'
[✓] root dir exists.
+ ssh -p 2222 -o BatchMode=yes -o 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes' -o 'ConnectTimeout 25' -i "<CONFIG_DIR>/id_rsa" deploy@example.com 'cd "/var/www/demo"'
[✓] DB(demo): mysql username, password and db are good.
+ ssh -p 2222 -o BatchMode=yes -o 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes' -o 'ConnectTimeout 25' -i "<CONFIG_DIR>/id_rsa" deploy@example.com 'mysql --user=dbuser --password="secret" --host=localhost demo --execute="exit";'
